from: the General Computing courses chat (rhino case)
why: Chris, 10 October 2026: "rhino course can use more pictures - they are beautiful". Twelve more coloured-pencil scenes for the Grade 9 SQL course, in the same style as 2026-10-09-sql9-scenes (brand/sql9-art-style.md); placed with Sql9Scene() in content/sql9/ once picked. No harm shown: no weapons, no injured animals. Do not run while the GPU is busy with videos (Chris).
style: realistic coloured pencil drawing on warm off-white paper, visible pencil strokes and paper texture, natural colours, soft Limpopo bushveld light, wildlife field-guide illustration, no text, no letters, no logos
